paragraphs: The entry says Rav Yehudah of Hagronya came before Rav Huna bar Minyomi. See there. [In Avodah Zarah 39a, Chanan the tailor tells Rav Huna that he, Chanan, went before Rav Yehudah of Hagronya.]
